semantic.justification: Native ordered content sequence parsing and extension-first lookup plus actual SAX writer metadata output, including source whitespace and strict relation attribute names. Ports only the consumed XML/package contract; native UNO services, general storage hierarchy, encrypted/ZIP64 packages, XLSB RecordParser and complete application document filters are outside this prerequisite. Strings/byte arrays and Promises bind host XML/ZIP transport; whole-module parity remains unverified. V4DQJW adds original ordered relationship-sequence reading: qualified root/child depth, required Id only, optional fields in Id/Type/Target/TargetMode order, duplicate preservation and ignored text. Writer uses this original XRelationshipAccess contract rather than oox::RelationsFragment admission. Package input now returns actual Reference<XInputStream> values over the existing genuine SequenceInputStream and signed Sequence storage, with empty Reference for absent parts. Fragment input ownership, basename fallback and actual resolved-path InputSource feed native XMLFile2UTFConverter through the existing expanded-name SAX backend. OFOPXMLHelper accepts real InputSource. Writer document input returns Reference copies sharing position; local byte-to-XML decoder/getDocumentXml are removed, and parser/input/VBA intermediate/failure owners unwind explicitly. Actual UNO read exceptions caught by XmlFilterBase are destroyed. Short-prefix EOF loss CALC-363/WRITER238 is preserved and directly tested. ZIP remains a browser byte/package binding: complete XStorage/XStream/XRelationshipAccess, input-disconnection lifecycle, generated token/UNO fragment/StringPair services, StorageBase hierarchy, libxml2 parity, native ABI/thread/allocation unwind and full DOCX/XLSX model/filter/worker/UI acceptance remain incomplete. Existing open/save/autosave/recovery policy is preserved. Relationship reading now returns actual Sequence<Sequence<StringPair>> values and follows original outer growth, initialized four-field row, Id/Type/Target/TargetMode assignments and row shrink. Native SAL field assignment owns both OUStrings. Compiler Sequence lvalue views bind existing initialized pointer cells without construction/acquisition/destruction and follow real COW/realloc pointer replacement. Writer target scans borrow actual rows/fields; result, root-side-stream, failed construction and retained copies release real owners. Existing host URI/string and SAX transport, shape-error envelopes, content-type/output pairs, complete XStorage/XRelationshipAccess and DOCX/XLSX model/filter/worker/UI acceptance remain unverified or pending; no component service is fabricated. Existing open/save/autosave/recovery choices remain unchanged. Content-type reading now returns actual nested initialized Sequence<StringPair> rows; original root growth, append/default assignment, ordered duplicate retention and owned MIME lookup reuse genuine SAL/CPPU owners. WriteContentSequence consumes actual borrowed StringPair fields through AttributeList/SAX events without host pair reconstruction. ZipPackage WriteContentTypes uses original fixed FullPath0/Version1/MediaType2 slots, five actual default pairs, manifest-sized overrides followed by final shrink, original exact comparison and DirectoryHelper split semantics. ZipStorage supplies the original three-slot stream manifest including empty Version. CALC-494/WRITER425 preserve unchanged right output at leading/trailing token boundaries. Native parser short-prefix EOF result is tested through genuine InputSource; direct host XML text does not pass through the byte converter. Actual XStorage/XRelationshipAccess/XWriter services, host relationship output and complete DOCX/XLSX model/filter/Worker/UI acceptance remain pending. Native physical ABI/allocation/thread behavior is not certified; file/autosave/recovery choices are unchanged.
